title: gym_teacher_parkour_ban
display_title: My gym teacher banned me from the climbing wall, so I built my own on his lawn
beats: My gym teacher (41M) told the whole class I was 'too reckless' to touch the climbing wall again, effective immediately.
Fine. I found out through a mutual friend that he'd been bragging about his brand new backyard fence for weeks.
Turns out he lived four houses from my best friend, and that fence backed right up to a public greenway.
So on Saturday, I 'accidentally' left my Minecraft parkour course, in real life, made of scaffolding planks, right along that public side of his fence.
Legal. Permitted. Photographed. And absolutely towering over his precious flower beds.
Monday he corners me, furious, asking if that was mine.
I told him I wasn't allowed to be reckless at school anymore, so I practice at home now, technically on public land.
He tried to get it condemned. City inspector said it met code better than his fence did. Was I wrong?
